name: Sofia Ricci
dataset: Health ReWireD minimal dataset – metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC), v0.3
mdt: Colorectal tumour board · Thursday 08:30 · Room MDT-2

documents.text: Biopt sigmoid: matig gedifferentieerd adenocarcinoom. Invasie tot in het pericolische vetweefsel (pT3). 2 van 14 lymfeklieren positief (pN1b). Geen lymfovasculaire invasie beschreven.
Dossier discuté en RCP. Sur le compte rendu initial, statut RAS sauvage. Début de FOLFOX avec bevacizumab le 12/09/2025, 8 cycles prévus. Patiente informée des effets indésirables.
CT Thorax/Abdomen: multiple Lebermetastasen in Segment VI und VII, größenprogredient. Zusätzlich ein unklarer pulmonaler Rundherd von 6 mm im rechten Unterlappen, Kontrolle empfohlen. Kein Aszites.
Analisi NGS su tessuto sigmoideo: mutazione KRAS p.G12C confermata (VAF 31%). Stato dei microsatelliti: MSS (stabile). Nessuna analisi BRAF riportata in questo referto.
Patiënte is goed zelfredzaam, doet zelf de boodschappen en fietst korte stukken. Wel toenemende vermoeidheid in de middag.

fields.label: RAS / KRAS status
fields.why: Two documents disagree. The molecular report is newer and tissue-based; the earlier consultation note quotes an initial report.

evidence.quote: Sur le compte rendu initial, statut RAS sauvage.
evidence.translation: On the initial report, RAS wild-type status.

fields.label: Performance status (ECOG)
fields.why: The note describes function, not a score. The assistant does not convert it into an ECOG value on its own.

evidence.quote: Patiënte is goed zelfredzaam, doet zelf de boodschappen en fietst korte stukken. Wel toenemende vermoeidheid in de middag.
evidence.translation: Patient is fully self-sufficient, does her own shopping and cycles short distances. Increasing fatigue in the afternoon.

fields.label: BRAF status
fields.why: No document reports a BRAF result. Left empty rather than assumed wild-type.

evidence.quote: Nessuna analisi BRAF riportata in questo referto.
evidence.translation: No BRAF analysis reported in this document.

fields.label: Primary diagnosis
fields.proposed: Adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon, moderately differentiated
options: Adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon, moderately differentiated
fields.why: Stated explicitly in the pathology report.

fields.label: Stage (TNM)
fields.why: T and N from pathology, M1 from the German CT report describing liver metastases.

evidence.quote: Invasie tot in het pericolische vetweefsel (pT3). 2 van 14 lymfeklieren positief (pN1b).
evidence.translation: Invasion into pericolic fat (pT3). 2 of 14 lymph nodes positive (pN1b).

evidence.quote: multiple Lebermetastasen in Segment VI und VII, größenprogredient
evidence.translation: multiple liver metastases in segments VI and VII, increasing in size

fields.label: Metastatic sites
fields.why: The 6 mm pulmonary nodule is described as unclear and scheduled for follow-up, so it is not counted as a metastasis.

evidence.quote: Zusätzlich ein unklarer pulmonaler Rundherd von 6 mm im rechten Unterlappen, Kontrolle empfohlen.
evidence.translation: In addition an unclear 6 mm pulmonary nodule in the right lower lobe, follow-up recommended.

fields.label: Microsatellite status
fields.why: Reported directly in the Italian molecular report.

fields.label: Prior systemic treatment
fields.why: From the French consultation note; the number of cycles actually given is not confirmed anywhere.

evidence.quote: Début de FOLFOX avec bevacizumab le 12/09/2025, 8 cycles prévus.
evidence.translation: Start of FOLFOX with bevacizumab on 12/09/2025, 8 cycles planned.

answer_key.diagnosis: Adenocarcinoma of the sigmoid colon, moderately differentiated
